problem.question: The chef has 60 eggs. He puts 10 eggs in the fridge and uses the rest to make cakes. If he used 5 eggs to make one cake, how many cakes did the chef make?
problem.answer:
After putting 10 eggs in the fridge, the chef has 60 - 10 = <<60-10=50>>50 eggs left to make cakes.
Since it takes 5 eggs to make one cake, the chef can make 50 eggs ÷ 5 eggs per cake = <<50/5=10>>10 cakes.
#### 10

generation.text:
The chef used 60 - 10 = 50 eggs to make cakes.
The chef made 50 / 5 = 10 cakes.
The final answer is \boxed{10}.
